name: retrieval
description: Knowledge retrieval eval (SPEC-11 S11-R-08): each case is a task, `expected` are the items a good ranking puts in the top 5. Items are ranked in memory with the FTS5 index and scoring of learning.retrieve; author self|related|other, a higher id is newer. Ranking weights (retrieval_w_* settings) change only when recall@5 does not drop.

items.text: SQLite allows one writer: open database writes inside the existing session, never a second connection, or the commit fails with 'database is locked'.
items.author: other

items.text: Retry the request with exponential backoff when the model provider answers 429 or 5xx.
items.author: related

items.text: FastAPI dependencies run per request; put the current user check in Depends so every admin route is covered.
items.author: self

items.text: pytest fixtures with tmp_path keep every test offline in its own data directory.

items.text: A git worktree on its own branch keeps agent edits away from the main checkout; remove the worktree after the merge.
items.author: related

items.text: Alembic was not needed: new columns are added at start-up by comparing the model with the table.
items.author: other

items.text: Escaping HTML in the dashboard: build DOM nodes with textContent instead of innerHTML for any user text.
items.author: self

items.text: Long-running subprocesses need their own process group so a timeout can kill the whole tree.
items.author: other

items.text: Large JSON responses from the trace endpoint: page the runs instead of returning every row.
items.author: other

items.text: The pytest suite failed because a test wrote to the shared data directory; isolate it with monkeypatch of DATA_DIR.
items.author: self

items.text: WebSocket handlers must check the Origin header before accepting the connection.
items.author: related

items.text: Use SQLite FTS5 with an external-content table and triggers to search text columns quickly.
items.author: other

items.text: Rate limits of the model provider: read the retry-after header and wait at most a minute.
items.author: other

items.text: Merging a goal branch needs the main repository on the base branch; otherwise refuse and tell the user.
items.author: other

items.text: The dashboard rail order is shared by all users; store it as a JSON setting, not in local storage.

items.text: Do not open a second database connection while a session is open in SQLite.

items.text: Markdown rendering in the chat panel: sanitise links so javascript: URLs never run.

items.text: pytest -q with xdist was flaky because tests shared a port; give each server test a free port.
items.author: other
